Pancakes with Berry Sauce
Servings4
Time30 minutes

Pancakes with a sauce, ingredients split into subsections and a nested list.

Ingredients

[edit]

Pancakes

[edit]
  • 200 g flour
  • 2 eggs
  • 300 ml milk
    • or 300 ml oat milk for a dairy-free version

Sauce

[edit]
  • 150 g mixed berries
  • 1 tablespoon sugar

Procedure

[edit]

Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.

Fry ladlefuls of batter in a hot pan until bubbles form, then flip.

Simmer the berries with the sugar for five minutes and spoon over the pancakes.

Notes

Leftover sauce keeps for two days.
